images.description: Worker mobile home screen showing the company switcher dropdown set to Whitefleet, with a green 'On the clock' attendance card showing roster-triggered clock-in. Bottom nav exposes Today, Schedule, Tasks, and Wallet surfaces.
images.altText: Worker mobile app home with company switcher and attendance card

images.description: Company admin task board for the Night Shift (18:00–06:00) with four columns — To Do, In Progress, Done, Verified — showing 12 tasks total. Cards carry priority tags (High/Medium), due dates, and worker avatars.
images.altText: Admin task kanban board with four status columns and shift header

images.description: OpenStreetMap live map with a blue geofence radius circle centred on a suburb, red worker location pins scattered across the city grid, and filter tabs showing Geofences 3, Workers 6, Assets 7.
images.altText: Live map with geofence circle and worker pins across city streets

images.description: Worker mobile task screen for 'General inspection of site' showing submitted photo evidence in a green Completion Evidence panel alongside an orange 'Awaiting verification' banner — the task lifecycle from submission to supervisor review.
images.altText: Mobile task screen with photo evidence submitted awaiting supervisor verification

images.description: My Team table listing six workers across Mining and Construction departments with Clock Status, Active Tasks, Assets, and Compliance columns. One worker shows '1 pending' compliance in orange; a Needs Attention counter flags the issue at the top.
images.altText: Team list showing compliance status, clock status, and tasks per worker

images.description: WhiteFleet Platform document library listing Australian labour-hire compliance documents — National Police Check, Forklift Licence (HRWL), Security Licence, White Card, Driver Licence — all typed as Wallet, making each a worker-owned credential.
images.altText: Platform document library listing compliance credentials typed as Wallet

images.description: Platform-admin audit log with timestamped entries and colour-coded action badges — green for create, orange for update, red for delete — covering role template creation, company registration approvals, and a company deletion event.
images.altText: Platform audit log with colour-coded action badges and timestamps

images.description: Company admin dashboard for a Whitefleet tenant with four stat cards (Total Employees 6, Attendance Today, Pending Approvals, Open Tasks 11), a Weekly Check-ins bar chart, and a Recent Employees list showing active membership status.
images.altText: Company admin dashboard with employee stats and weekly check-in chart

images.description: WhiteFleet Platform admin dashboard showing 2 companies registered, Active Subscriptions and Pending Approvals stats, a Weekly Activity bar chart of company registrations, and a Quick Actions panel linking to approvals, documents, and role templates.
images.altText: Platform admin dashboard showing two companies and weekly registration activity

images.description: Worker mobile task detail for 'General inspection of site' listing status (Assigned), priority (High), due date, and a $200.00 fixed payment rate alongside completion requirements and assignee history, with a Start Task CTA.
images.altText: Mobile task detail showing priority, payment, and completion requirements

images.description: All Employees table for a company with six members showing role badge variety — Employee, Accountant, Admin, Supervisor — filtered by status and role, with department count and join timestamps per row.
images.altText: Employee table with role badges spanning Employee, Accountant, Admin, Supervisor

images.description: Global search modal over a dimmed Attendance page backdrop, showing results for 'D' grouped into Overview (Dashboard), People (Departments, Designations), HRM (Attendance, Holidays), Operations (Today's Tasks), and Compliance sections.
images.altText: Global search modal with grouped navigation results over dimmed background

images.description: Worker mobile Settings screen with Account section containing Email, Profile, and Switch Company rows, an Appearance toggle (System/Light/Dark with Light selected), Notifications, and app version v1.0.0.
images.altText: Mobile settings screen showing switch company option and appearance controls

images.description: Worker mobile Tasks screen showing a red '1 Overdue' summary card above an Active section with a single inspection task card bearing Assigned and Overdue status badges alongside a $200.00 fixed payment chip.
images.altText: Mobile tasks screen with one overdue task and payment badge

images.description: Add Completion Details modal for a site inspection task with a dashed photo upload zone (camera icon, 'Tap to take or upload a photo', JPG/PNG up to 10 MB) and Cancel/Submit buttons in green.
images.altText: Mobile completion details modal with photo upload zone and submit button

images.description: Worker mobile Notifications screen with two push notification cards: a task overdue alert for 'General inspection of site' dated Aug 2, and a new task assignment notification for the same task.
images.altText: Mobile notifications showing task overdue and new task assigned alerts
